title: The Frida Cinema

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Frida Cinema’s two 200+-seat auditoriums play host to hundreds of events every year. With digital projection and audio, professional lighting, stage, and wireless microphones, The Frida’s auditoriums are ideal venues for a number of events including: Film Screenings - Student Film Screenings - Film Festivals - Live Music - Live Comedy - Weddings - Birthday Parties Celebrations of Life - Lectures - Fundraisers - Multi-Media Event - Game Nights - Drag Shows - Fashion Shows - Children’s Parties Please complete the form below for a member of our team to contact you with rental rate information. Discounts are available for nonprofit organizations, educational groups, and student filmmakers.
